# Evolution Stables

> NZTR-authorised digital racehorse syndicator. Fractional thoroughbred ownership for New Zealand investors — transparent terms, regulated settlement, no crypto product.

Evolution Stables offers digital-syndication ownership of thoroughbred racehorses under New Zealand Thoroughbred Racing (NZTR) rules and the Financial Markets Conduct Act framework for authorised syndicators. Settlement and ownership records are handled with Tokinvest, a VARA-licensed platform. Racehorse investment carries risk; returns are not guaranteed.

## What we are
- NZTR authorised syndicator (Bloodstock Syndicator Code of Practice)
- Digital-syndication platform for thoroughbred ownership (not a betting product)
- Regulated real-world asset (RWA) style exposure to racehorse campaigns
- Partners: Wexford Stables, Stephen Gray Racing, B.A.X Bloodstock, Tokinvest

## What we are not
- Not a cryptocurrency, token-sale, or unregulated investment scheme
- Not guaranteed returns, yield, or passive income
- Not a TAB, bookmaker, or betting platform
- Not speaking for Tokinvest’s own products or licences beyond the partnership role
